mapper.select: SELECT N.flight_notice_id, N.flight_id, N.notice_type, N.reason, N.delay_minutes, N.created_by, TO_CHAR(N.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS created_at, F.flight_no, M.login_id AS creator_id FROM FLIGHT_NOTICE N JOIN FLIGHT F ON N.flight_id = F.flight_id LEFT JOIN MEMBER M ON N.created_by = M.member_id ORDER BY N.created_at DESC
mapper.update:
UPDATE FLIGHT SET
flight_status = CASE WHEN #{notice_type} = 'DELAY' THEN 'DELAYED' WHEN #{notice_type} = 'CANCEL' THEN 'CANCELLED' END, delay_minutes = #{delay_minutes, jdbcType=INTEGER}, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE flight_id = #{flight_id}
